title: Zenith Japanese Tofu Noodles
description: A nutty and bouncy Japanese dish featuring unsalted butter and ferment, perfect for a solo dinner, and is shojin-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the Japanese noodles according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and set them aside.
In a large skillet, melt the unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the sesame oil and stir to combine.
Add the miso paste, rice vinegar, and sugar, and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the scallions, sesame seeds, and fermented soybeans, and toss to combine.
Cut the tofu into small cubes and add it to the skillet.
Toss the noodles and tofu to combine and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the Zenith Japanese Tofu Noodles hot and enjoy.
